intro: Connectors are the glue that turns short answers into real conversation. Learn these 12 and you'll never be stuck at “Sí. / No.” again.

connectors.use: Agree or add something: yo también = me too (with gustar: a mí también).

example.en: I study English and I also work.

connectors.use: Add one more, stronger point – often at the start of a sentence.

example.latam: Me gusta Alcalá. Además, la comida es muy rica.
example.en: I like Alcalá. Besides, the food is delicious.

example.latam: Soy de Inglaterra, pero vivo en Alcalá.
example.en: I'm from England, but I live in Alcalá.

connectors.use: A stronger, slightly more formal pero; usually starts a sentence.

example.latam: El tren es caro. Sin embargo, es muy cómodo.
example.en: The train is expensive. However, it's very comfortable.

connectors.use: Give a reason. Don't mix it up with ¿por qué? (why?).

example.latam: Estoy cansada porque tengo muchas clases.
example.en: I'm tired because I have lots of classes.

connectors.use: Give the result of something you just said.

example.latam: Me encanta la historia, por eso vivo en Alcalá.
example.en: I love history, that's why I live in Alcalá.

connectors.use: Draw a conclusion or move the conversation on.

example.en: It's free? Then I'm coming back tomorrow.

connectors.use: Link two actions in time (¿cuándo? with accent is the question).

example.en: When it rains, I take the bus.

connectors.use: Two things at the same time – essential for telling stories in the past.

example.latam: Escucho música mientras viajo en tren.
example.en: I listen to music while I travel by train.

connectors.use: Buy time, soften an answer, or close a chat (“Bueno, me voy”).

example.en: Well… I don't know. What do you think?

connectors.use: React or decide while thinking. Hugely common in Spain.

example.en: —Do you like it? —Well yes, a lot!

connectors.use: Explain or rephrase what you just said – a lifesaver when you lack a word.

example.latam: Son doce euros, o sea, es barato.
example.en: It's twelve euros, so it's cheap.
